build_image_transform_pipeline: build a torchvision transform pipeline for training or inference with configurable image size and normalization
create_resize_max_size_transform: create a ResizeMaxSize transform that resizes images to fit within a max size and pads to square
create_maskget_transform: create a Maskget transform that extracts a binary mask from an image based on a mean color threshold
create_erosion_augmentation: create an Erosion augmentation transform that applies random morphological erosion to image regions
create_normalize_with_mask: create a Normalize_w_mask transform that normalizes a tensor image while preserving its accompanying mask
